definitions.gloss: what kind of, what sort of
definitions.explanation: Used to ask about the nature or type of something.

examples.japanese: どんな⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What kind of movies do you like?

examples.japanese: どんな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What kind of person is he/she?

examples.japanese: どんな⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll do my best no matter what.

examples.japanese: どんな⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What kind of food do you like?

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{忙|いそが}しくても→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ようにしている→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how busy I am, I try to read a little every day.
examples.notes: どんなに〜ても = no matter how ~

notes:
どんな is a pre-noun adjectival that asks about the nature, type, or quality of something. It always modifies a noun directly.

KO-SO-A-DO SERIES:
- ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧: this kind of (near speaker)
- ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧: that kind of (near listener)
- ⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧: that kind of (far from both)
- どんな: what kind of (question)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どんな + noun: どんな⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧？ (What kind of book?)
- どんなに〜ても: no matter how ~ (どんなに⟦{難|むずか}しくても→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ = no matter how difficult)
- どんな⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧: at any time, no matter when
- どんな⟦{事|こと}→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あっても→ある：00006_aru⟧: no matter what happens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どんな: casual, everyday question about type/nature
- ⟦どういう→どういう：noentry⟧: slightly more formal, asks about the manner or reasoning
- ⟦どのような→どのような：09961_donoyouna⟧: formal/written equivalent of どんな
